claims.text: The classifiers used in the study are Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, which are a type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN).
An ensemble of LSTM classifiers was utilized to improve classification performance.
The study experimented with various setups of LSTM classifiers to enhance detection of hateful content.
